stage0049_03:r_38762a09460d8b6b.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「You... do you intend to go to Orb alone?」

stage0049_03:r_b05f6a6e8f3d9b24.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「UG forces are deployed along $c's course.
　Breaking through it alone in the Destiny is...」

stage0049_03:r_1d6bc48b7f246730.text:
$$ミシェル$$
「$$カミーユ$$ didn't come to stop you」

stage0049_03:r_4d863c3fb88a4c39.text:
$$ルカ$$
「Skull Squadron will move ahead of $c's main force
　and pin down UG's defense units.
　Meanwhile, $$シン$$, head to Orb by a different route」

stage0049_03:r_44f4742c3dcce39a.text:
$$ルカ$$
「We'll use the $$Ｚガンダム$$ as a sub-flight unit
　to keep the Destiny's wear to a minimum」

stage0049_03:r_9e701cdeb3842c21.text:
$$アルト$$
「Be grateful to $$カミーユ$$.
　He didn't just get this plan approved,
　he's giving you a ride too」

stage0049_03:r_da2132b5038ec737.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「Your feelings for Orb...
　go settle them here」

stage0049_03:r_182faded068c15ed.text:
$$宗介$$
「The enemy you're pursuing... an angel is nearby?」

stage0049_03:r_6e558bc69acf5bf3.text:
$$シン$$
（UG and an angel...
　What's happening in Orb...）

stage0049_03:r_43e4e548c0b28376.text: ～ Union of Orb Emirates Representative's Residence ～

stage0049_03:r_708bea61e3c43ada.text:
$$キサカ$$
「We've defeated the enemy's first wave, but the
　Archangel took heavy damage. The Akatsuki is intact,
　but under 10% of our mobile suits can still fight」

stage0049_03:r_7b6f159eeaf4de0f.text:
$$カガリ$$
「Have Captain Ramius's group cover the citizens'
　evacuation. We must get that done before UG's
　second wave arrives」

stage0049_03:r_0827963cfd706e8d.text:
$$キサカ$$
「Understood.
　I'll arrange it at once」

stage0049_03:r_ff6f8bdca2dd2bc9.text:
$$カガリ$$
「I'm counting on you, $$キサカ$$...」

stage0049_03:r_567b361a454c4b73.text:
$$カガリ$$
「Rest assured, Lady $$マリナ$$.
　I will protect you without fail」

stage0049_03:r_d22851aaafbbf8fc.text:
$$カガリ$$
「Once an evacuation route for the citizens is
　secured, please escape together with them」

stage0049_03:r_79f2664edb1af798.text:
$$カガリ$$
「It's a shame.
　You came all this way, Lady $$マリナ$$, and I meant
　to discuss what comes next...」

stage0049_03:r_a62c4e7f3c09f7ed.text:
$$マリナ$$
「And yet, it's come to this...」

stage0049_03:r_1c5aa0d15ae24846.text:
$$カガリ$$
「Orb has worked to become a bridge between
　Earth and the colonies」

stage0049_03:r_53bb64ee17750ee2.text:
$$カガリ$$
「As the war between the Federation and Neo Zeon
　in space grows fiercer by the day, I hear more
　people see Orb's existence as a hope」

stage0049_03:r_7a7add80fde475ba.text:
$$マリナ$$
「Vice Minister Darlian and I have supported
　Representative Athha and worked toward
　that end until today」

stage0049_03:r_b2befefdbed1393d.text:
$$マリナ$$
「That we could push through the interference of
　those who resented it is entirely thanks
　to Orb's existence」

stage0049_03:r_2103f6df2ea2e447.text:
$$カガリ$$
「I don't know why UG is targeting Orb.
　But I will protect you, Lady $$マリナ$$, the flame
　of hope who shares our will, no matter what」

stage0049_03:r_a12e3e130d896ff7.text:
$$カガリ$$
「Even at the cost of my own life」

stage0049_03:r_91bf33c27ad39f0a.text:
$$カガリ$$
「Lady $$マリナ$$... this isn't meant as payment
　in kind, but might I ask one favor of you?」

stage0049_03:r_ee220318b96ab538.text:
$$マリナ$$
「If it's something I can do」

stage0049_03:r_ce1b55e526b6277a.text:
$$カガリ$$
「My father, and the previous Chief Representative
　of Orb, Uzumi Nara Athha, also died for
　his ideals」

stage0049_03:r_c304df6888eb78f7.text:
$$カガリ$$
「I've taken up that will, and I intend to
　never yield to senseless violence. Orb's
　soldiers stand with me in that」

stage0049_03:r_c26958634526e597.text:
$$カガリ$$
「But I don't want to drag the citizens
　into that fight」

stage0049_03:r_cdb750c9d380881a.text:
$$カガリ$$
「Lady $$マリナ$$... if Orb should ever burn,
　could Azadistan take in the citizens
　who evacuated?」

stage0049_03:r_95fda74613c97b39.text:
$$マリナ$$
「Understood. I promise you this,
　on behalf of Azadistan」

stage0049_03:r_1956994937f8171e.text:
$$マリナ$$
「But, Representative Athha... you must not
　die either. Please escape together
　with the citizens」

stage0049_03:r_0ebc5a6f1e0f81bf.text:
$$マリナ$$
「Why not? Even if you carry on your
　father's will, if you should lose
　your life...」

stage0049_03:r_f02c37d91387d0ad.text:
$$カガリ$$
「I once fled from this country before」

stage0049_03:r_9796b3efa401a303.text:
$$カガリ$$
「At the time, it may have been the only way.
　But I won't forget that it prolonged the
　chaos and made so many people suffer...」

stage0049_03:r_643b6eebfc0186b3.text:
$$カガリ$$
「So this time, I won't run away, not
　to the very end」

stage0049_03:r_32eb462c1b4999cb.text:
$$カガリ$$
「Orb's ideals have reached every single
　citizen. Even if we lose our nation, or
　lose our representative, that ideal survives」

stage0049_03:r_1f4337d6d393fc37.text:
$$カガリ$$
「Besides, there are people who share our
　will, starting with you, Lady $$マリナ$$, and
　Vice Minister Darlian. There's nothing to fear」

stage0049_03:r_4740e748fae085ee.text:
$$マリナ$$
「To think you'd made up your mind
　to that extent...」

stage0049_03:r_b76524cd840e1d37.text:
$$カガリ$$
「Please, lift your head, Lady $$マリナ$$.
　It's not as if I'm hoping to die」

stage0049_03:r_730ffe18400abfc2.text:
$$カガリ$$
「Reinforcements from the Federation's
　Pacific branch will arrive soon. Once
　they get here...」

stage0049_03:r_ffe0fca26da5cd38.text:
$$キサカ$$
「Representative...!
　Unidentified units are approaching Orb!」

stage0049_03:r_859dfa27bcaafe30.text:
$$キサカ$$
「No... this is likely a different force
　from them」

stage0049_03:r_2113dcbabdfc758a.text: ～ Union of Orb Emirates Representative's Residence ～

stage0049_03:r_4b0e43ba6a5f2f5b.text:
$$カガリ$$
「You saved us, $$シン$$.
　Thanks to you, Orb has been saved」

stage0049_03:r_5b992878fee054b5.text:
$$カガリ$$
「I am Orb's representative. I'm no longer
　allowed to abandon my country and flee」

stage0049_03:r_95a3dd16c2c4cc3e.text:
$$シン$$
「That's admirable. You're truly a Chief
　Representative now, not just in name」

stage0049_03:r_4a14ec0c511c7f0d.text:
$$カガリ$$
「As you put it, pretty words are the Athha
　family's specialty」

stage0049_03:r_b591d812c96c6c99.text:
$$カガリ$$
「Because to me, it's a word of caution」

stage0049_03:r_e350fa099c1ab072.text:
$$シン$$
「...You win, Representative. Back then...
　when I snapped at you aboard the
　Minerva... I'm sorry」

stage0049_03:r_fb05d8e5f1ee93e5.text:
$$カガリ$$
「There's no need. Back then, I was
　certainly still immature」

stage0049_03:r_bccc48e1964ad22d.text:
$$カガリ$$
「Let me say it again, $$シン$$.
　Thanks to you, Orb has been saved」

stage0049_03:r_f8736aaaa216c766.text:
$$カガリ$$
「Thank you. ...And let me say this on
　behalf of Orb」

stage0049_03:r_3bc7834a5bf3ee76.text:
$$キラ$$
「Good for you, $$シン$$. And you too, $$カガリ$$」

stage0049_03:r_366814efdc8b5800.text:
$$カガリ$$
「I'm grateful to you too, $$キラ$$.
　Thank you for coming all the way from
　$$プラント$$」

stage0049_03:r_9be1a4c10bb62515.text:
$$カガリ$$
「But if you were coming, you could
　have come a little sooner」

stage0049_03:r_1c208ca0cbf26f28.text:
$$カガリ$$
「I'm joking. ...Still, you never change,
　too honest for your own good」

stage0049_03:r_5b7ee307a700171a.text:
$$キラ$$
「$$アスラン$$ and the others tell me that too」

stage0049_03:r_f5432119677514f7.text:
$$キラ$$
「Yeah... though $$プラント$$ keeps leaning
　more toward war」

stage0049_03:r_4e5c8e989c4a7691.text:
$$キラ$$
「At this rate, we may end up fighting the
　Earth Federation alongside Neo Zeon
　eventually」

stage0049_03:r_adec86483b13599a.text:
$$シン$$
「But if it becomes clear that those Geminis
　people started the war...!」

stage0049_03:r_2cf701bbcde3ec13.text:
$$カガリ$$
「Unfortunately, things have already gone
　past the point where how it started
　matters」

stage0049_03:r_c17c58fdba72005e.text:
$$カガリ$$
「Even if we made the origin clear now,
　neither side could sheathe their
　swords anymore」

stage0049_03:r_1fe8564d2b959317.text:
$$カガリ$$
「As today's battle shows, there are people
　within the Earth Federation who want
　war too」

stage0049_03:r_f527e012803f7f1c.text:
$$キラ$$
「Even so, all we can do is keep doing
　what we can... what we should」

stage0049_03:r_00c55e25f87b71d0.text:
$$キラ$$
「I've left $$プラント$$ to $$ラクス$$ and the others.
　I'll fight alongside $c」

stage0049_03:r_0c8ea89b07432421.text:
$$シン$$
「Oh, yes...! You must be Lady
　$$マリナ・イスマイール$$, right?」

stage0049_03:r_4dbfba00ba7744ee.text:
$$マリナ$$
「Yes... $$ＺＥＸＩＳ$$ helped me so much during
　the $$破界事変$$ and $$再世戦争$$」

stage0049_03:r_be100a32b731708d.text:
$$シン$$
「Um... well... $$刹那$$'s... uh...
　probably doing maintenance on his unit
　or something, so he's not here, maybe...」

stage0049_03:r_702f82442fcec8a9.text:
$$マリナ$$
「It's fine. I've learned that he still
　holds his wish for peace, even now」

stage0049_03:r_b1e38da4e8775ffe.text:
$$マリナ$$
「If you're returning to $c, please
　give this to him」

stage0049_03:r_3dad695c99e9e052.text:
$$マリナ$$
「As you know, during the $$再世戦争$$,
　Azadistan's land was once burned」

stage0049_03:r_66d4ae3a21caf881.text:
$$シン$$
（Was that during the fight with
　《$$アロウズ$$》...）

stage0049_03:r_0c18da7b3a37825d.text:
$$マリナ$$
「But the war ended, and thanks to the
　efforts of many people, Azadistan was
　able to rebuild」

stage0049_03:r_63249745ffae61b6.text:
$$マリナ$$
「This flower is a preserved flower, made
　from one that bloomed in the scorched fields
　when I returned to Azadistan」

stage0049_03:r_abdb034ae8509702.text:
$$マリナ$$
「Whenever hardship nearly broke my will,
　I'd look at this flower and renew my hope for peace」

stage0049_03:r_3ff2e21207d1d1d3.text:
$$シン$$
「Is it okay to give away something so important?
　That guy probably doesn't even care about flowers...」

stage0049_03:r_e51ecf6d6aa42e75.text:
$$カガリ$$
「That's rude, $$シン$$...!
　This man named $$刹那$$ is someone
　very dear to Lady $$マリナ$$...!」

stage0049_03:r_b025267f22788233.text:
$$マリナ$$
「Please don't worry about it.
　I don't think flowers suit $$刹那$$ either」

stage0049_03:r_ec1a06a7023bf72c.text:
$$マリナ$$
「Also... he really is dear to me,
　but not quite in the sense of... a man」

stage0049_03:r_124591cb154fae64.text:
$$シン$$
「Then all the more reason
　not to give away something so important...」

stage0049_03:r_7bdb6fecc8b3bde8.text:
$$マリナ$$
「From here on, $$刹那$$ will surely walk
　a harsher path than I ever did.
　I hope it can comfort him, even a little, then」

stage0049_03:r_4bf9b05b5f948170.text:
$$マリナ$$
「From now on, when I feel like giving in,
　I'll think of $$刹那$$ instead of the flower.
　I'm sure that will renew my hope for peace」

stage0049_03:r_b4bc9e9435b58e6f.text:
$$キラ$$
「Understood.
　I'll make sure this flower reaches $$刹那$$」

stage0049_03:r_a9227573166977a9.text:
$$カガリ$$
「$$キラ$$, $$シン$$...
　you two take care as well」

stage0049_03:r_b0600ab9a9e8559d.text:
$$カガリ$$
「Just as that man $$刹那$$ is to Lady $$マリナ$$,
　you two are hope to me as well」

stage0049_03:r_07f53c816e0a51f5.text:
$$シン$$
「Orb is our hope too.
　We'll fight to protect it」

stage0049_03:r_2d09c6f6a2d990ea.text:
$$シン$$
（I'm heading out, Mayu... Dad, Mom...）

stage0049_03:r_e370696b8936b08c.text:
$$イアン$$
「Been a while, everyone.
　Looks like you're all doing fine」

stage0049_03:r_9d7b02c5e728b7aa.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「Glad to see you're safe too, $$イアン$$」

stage0049_03:r_9af213fc64e0afec.text:
$$デュオ$$
「Looks like the old man's aged a bit more」

stage0049_03:r_d7f1c506e78e55ff.text:
$$トロワ$$
「That'll make the gap with his wife stand out more」

stage0049_03:r_0c705091f748360e.text:
$$イアン$$
「I never thought I'd hear
　something like that from you...」

stage0049_03:r_9eb8599304125b2f.text:
$$デュオ$$
「Guess even $$トロワ$$ can't help roasting this couple」

stage0049_03:r_a072aa25e5f521e0.text:
$$クルツ$$
「So, who's the one piloting that green Gundam?」

stage0049_03:r_24e1a808a1609a1a.text:
$$イアン$$
「You mean Zanbanya...
　Hey, $$ロックオン$$... you've got a visitor」

stage0049_03:r_53128ce8f154fd06.text:
$$ロックオン$$
「You need something from me?」

stage0049_03:r_03b5db9ce98fb8d6.text:
$$クルツ$$
「It ain't just 'something.'
　I'm $$ウルズ$$ 6 of the $$トゥアハー・デ・ダナン$$...!
　Don't you dare say you don't know me!」

stage0049_03:r_3915fb4102f1c1dd.text:
$$ロックオン$$
「...No idea what you're talking about」

stage0049_03:r_817b2773b4ed563e.text:
$$クルツ$$
「Come on, man!
　After all we went through together
　during the $$破界事変$$, you're just gonna ice me out?!」

stage0049_03:r_1cc233cbc8c80af7.text:
$$マオ$$
「Celestial Being picked a fight with the whole world.
　That made them an enemy of $$ミスリル$$ too」

stage0049_03:r_3ce2f3e58cfdc3ba.text:
$$クルツ$$
「Me and you...!
　Snipers representing our own organizations,
　trading hot shots back and forth...!」

stage0049_03:r_e180b22d18f48d38.text:
$$クルツ$$
「Win and lose, lose and win...!
　Five wins, five losses!
　Don't tell me you forgot that legendary match!」

stage0049_03:r_e598c2a0b27e7f50.text:
$$ロックオン$$
「Sorry, but...
　that's the previous $$ロックオン$$... my brother's story」

stage0049_03:r_4d2a9066c4e7b27f.text:
$$ロックオン$$
「My real name is Lyle Dylandy...
　the twin younger brother of Neil Dylandy,
　the one you fought against」

stage0049_03:r_10340119af3ed6db.text:
$$クルツ$$
「So what happened to the previous one?」

stage0049_03:r_8fe40600ce62dfbc.text:
$$クルツ$$
「Kid brother... mind indulging me in some old memories?」

stage0049_03:r_ff4ce5f3cf96b617.text:
$$ロックオン$$
「Sure.
　I'd love to hear about you and my brother's sniper duels」

stage0049_03:r_d73c21f119847e35.text:
$$クルツ$$
「So, your Gundam...
　it looks a bit different from a sniper type...」

stage0049_03:r_89766f5ffaa912d4.text:
$$ロックオン$$
「My Zanbanya still shoots, sure,
　but it's more about quantity than quality.
　After all, I'm the lesser brother」

stage0049_03:r_c2df6b71e3b4b6ec.text:
$$デュオ$$
「That another one of the old man's builds?」

stage0049_03:r_451f726d4299ea35.text:
$$イアン$$
「Yeah, that's right.
　It's based on the Cherudim, but I redesigned
　the armaments to suit $$ロックオン$$'s style」

stage0049_03:r_e3d111e8bb190cb1.text:
$$ロックオン$$
「I'll build my own version of
　$$ロックオン・ストラトス$$ with that Zanbanya」

stage0049_03:r_7c0d3c51f9a11ca0.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「Looks like $$刹那$$ is still with the $$ダブルオーライザー$$」

stage0049_03:r_ab97c2b2418ea732.text:
$$イアン$$
「Yeah, well.
　But it's had the GN Drive removed,
　and now runs on GN particles from a storage tank」

stage0049_03:r_2ddff5064af78db4.text:
$$アムロ$$
「What happened to the Twin Drive?」

stage0049_03:r_050d0532c4b24bfe.text:
$$イアン$$
「That's being used as material for developing another unit」

stage0049_03:r_d583fcea31bdad2e.text:
$$刹那$$
「But even the current $$ダブルオーライザー$$ is combat-capable enough.
　There's no problem」

stage0049_03:r_475f7653621a91b5.text:
$$ヒイロ$$
「So you're saying the machine doesn't matter」

stage0049_03:r_f228ae702350849b.text:
$$刹那$$
「Take it that way if you like」

stage0049_03:r_d69dc027cba3003f.text:
$$ヒイロ$$
「You haven't changed, $$刹那・Ｆ・セイエイ$$」

stage0049_03:r_1f418b5594cea300.text:
$$クルツ$$
「What's this.
　Thought we had a new silent type,
　but you're surprisingly friendly」

stage0049_03:r_f87fb889124bfaef.text:
$$マオ$$
「$$ヒイロ$$'s talking more than usual too」

stage0049_03:r_79c90de32a79212d.text:
$$ロックオン$$
「These two go way back」

stage0049_03:r_33f7fd55913419e8.text:
$$マオ$$
「I see.
　Two silent-type Gundam pilots who just click, huh」

stage0049_03:r_473d9a88b4ca96e7.text:
$$クルツ$$
「Drop the 'Gundam pilot' label,
　add our $$宗介$$, $n, and $$キリコ$$,
　and that's the Silent Five, right there」

stage0049_03:r_ce90563a934d49fb.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「Not arguing there is exactly why they say that」

stage0049_03:r_4fb296e63cb1fb46.text:
$$アムロ$$
「There are things only words can convey.
　Don't forget that, $$刹那$$」

stage0049_03:r_6d77e72dbbcd7dfe.text:
$$刹那$$
「I'll keep that in mind, Captain $$アムロ$$」

stage0049_03:r_9dc59affd40f32fc.text:
$$カミーユ$$
（Seems like he's gotten a bit gentler.
　Maybe that's from awakening as an Innovator...）

stage0049_03:r_0cea115be526a319.text:
$$カトル$$
「Aren't $$アレルヤ$$, $$マリー$$,
　and $$ティエリア$$ here?」

stage0049_03:r_d36072babd12aeb4.text:
$$イアン$$
「$$アレルヤ$$ and $$マリー$$
　split up once the $$再世戦争$$ ended.
　We don't even know what they're doing now」

stage0049_03:r_09ee921a85025fd3.text:
$$カトル$$
「You don't even know where they are?」

stage0049_03:r_fae689f2a1057b61.text:
$$イアン$$
「Yeah, well.
　Those two are just people with no connection
　to Celestial Being anymore」

stage0049_03:r_91c6d0bb53854ecc.text:
$$谷川$$
「But we... more or less know
　where they are」

stage0049_03:r_d441e6cc908ac01b.text:
$$イアン$$
「Well, yeah...
　As comrades who fought together,
　I at least want to know they're doing fine」

stage0049_03:r_b2aab8873350ea1f.text:
$$中原$$
「Sometimes we get postcards addressed to
　$$２１世紀警備保障$$ from $$マリー$$」

stage0049_03:r_2c7af4c55d8ac938.text:
$$大山$$
「Last month was India, the month before that, Tibet, I think...」

stage0049_03:r_653b741d07545dff.text:
$$谷川$$
「Sounds like the two of them are
　traveling the world together, getting along fine」

stage0049_03:r_d584d4b5af55b1cf.text:
$$ロックオン$$
「Then I've got nothing to complain about」

stage0049_03:r_db0ee69ece206fcd.text:
$$刹那$$
「We're the ones who fight.
　They can live their lives their own way」

stage0049_03:r_422861e0b8d77d0c.text:
$$イアン$$
「He's holed up in Celestial Being's lab.
　He's accessing 《$$ヴェーダ$$》 and looking
　into all sorts of things」

stage0049_03:r_2b93cca10f1c36a8.text:
$$イアン$$
「Not sure myself, but it seems there's information
　deep in $$ヴェーダ$$ that even $$ティエリア$$ hasn't grasped.
　He's analyzing its protections right now」

stage0049_03:r_7980fd37141d88d0.text:
$$アムロ$$
「Even the Earth Federation, who seized
　《Celestial Being》, is apparently struggling
　to analyze its complex systems」

stage0049_03:r_ac21212c36d2b9ad.text:
$$イアン$$
「Which means $$ティエリア$$ can access it
　freely from the outside too」

stage0049_03:r_a26e2108358af7a4.text:
$$赤木$$
「Well, as long as they're doing fine, that's good enough」

stage0049_03:r_a8118b2e37aa1382.text:
$$青山$$
「The problem's UG, who's now revealed himself as Geminis...」

stage0049_03:r_017a56991b7b8ca4.text:
$$ロックオン$$
「We've been regularly sending the data we gathered
　on them to $$プリベンター$$ and Neo Zeon,
　but today was basically a declaration of war」

stage0049_03:r_ad3e1db3419665fb.text:
$$アムロ$$
「You were sending information to $$シャア$$'s side too?」

stage0049_03:r_0149e3a5f2e5ef78.text:
$$ロックオン$$
「Sorry to you Earth Federation folks,
　but we figured Neo Zeon had a point too」

stage0049_03:r_3ad10e705167a3fa.text:
$$ロックオン$$
「Of course, we can't condone war as a means,
　but at the very least, we decided the origin
　and truth of it should reach him too, fairly」

stage0049_03:r_bdc546b199c80996.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「I have no objection to that」

stage0049_03:r_22c8caf8c08c5119.text:
$$アムロ$$
「And we also recognize that the war
　has already gone too far to be stopped,
　even if its origin is known」

stage0049_03:r_9c13714b3efbc7a8.text:
$$刹那$$
「But we can't just leave them...
　leave Geminis alone」

stage0049_03:r_96f156e19b53fc09.text:
$$イアン$$
「Celestial Being will be
　acting as $c from now on, too」

stage0049_03:r_feb0390bba7fe1fb.text:
$$イアン$$
「We know you're all fighting
　beyond the divide between Earth and the colonies」

stage0049_03:r_8a78bcec22029401.text:
$$赤木$$
「So, is $$スメラギ$$ and the others
　discussing what to do from here...」

stage0049_03:r_f42017dfce31dea9.text:
$$アムロ$$
「Though our destination's probably already decided」

stage0049_03:r_ef7426919f628d8a.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「N23-32, E161-22... is that where?」

stage0049_03:r_9e994a4b926d9906.text:
$$アムロ$$
「We don't know who that man $$アドヴェント$$ is,
　but if he speaks of humanity's history ending,
　we can't help but go check for ourselves」

stage0049_03:r_ffae76d2a77abf5a.text:
$$デュオ$$
「Lucky for us, it's not far from Orb.
　We'll go check it out, and if it's a false alarm,
　we'll just have a laugh about it」

stage0049_03:r_3ac462d37e5893ff.text:
$$赤木$$
「And if it turns out to be true?」

stage0049_03:r_fd6bdf7910d7d925.text:
$$ロックオン$$
「...I don't even want to think about that...」

stage0049_03:r_d38be46e6cd7a5e5.text:
$$クルツ$$
「Same here.
　We've got our hands full with wars and invaders
　as it is, no room to deal with something that crazy」

stage0049_03:r_3fe2078328753c16.text:
$$刹那$$
「And we still don't know anything
　about Geminis' true nature or purpose」

stage0049_03:r_c66844158d1ce600.text:
$$カトル$$
「If they're aliens,
　is invading Earth their goal...」

stage0049_03:r_d037ecbc1e348dc9.text:
$$デュオ$$
「But even so,
　they're the type trying to pit humans
　against each other. Can't be much of a fighting force」

stage0049_03:r_bcd53d14c4785426.text:
$$アムロ$$
「But so far,
　Earth's been moved entirely as Geminis planned...
　It's dangerous to underestimate their strength」

stage0049_03:r_9ca55ea7feca954a.text:
$$刹那$$
「Geminis...
　just who are they, really...」

stage0049_03:r_aa5d235c78ebe19f.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Good work out there, Master $$シン$$, Master $$キラ$$」

stage0049_03:r_0b3b19cddb871f90.text:
$$キラ$$
「So you're $$ＡＧ$$.
　Cuter than I expected」

stage0049_03:r_304e98dac43c9333.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Oh, stop it...!
　Flattery like that won't get you anything!
　You're quite the smooth talker, Master $$キラ$$!」

stage0049_03:r_b740d817a14afd3a.text:
$$シン$$
「Says that, but looks pretty pleased about it」

stage0049_03:r_40e4c010d1b35b4c.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Well, of course.
　Master $$シン$$ and Master $$キラ$$ crushed the terrorists,
　so Master $$カガリ$$ handed over Z Chips」

stage0049_03:r_c33abf00683a32bc.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「That amount... a whopping 150Z!
　I'll add this to the squad's stock」

stage0049_03:r_019293cb83599509.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「That's thanks to the combination
　of Master $$シン$$ and Master $$キラ$$」

stage0049_03:r_9b949b9281aaeef1.text:
$$シン$$
「Say what you want, but $$キラ$$ and I
　used to be enemies」

stage0049_03:r_b39a1dd705fe6cbf.text:
$$キラ$$
「And I got shot down by $$シン$$, remember」

stage0049_03:r_c9016e3ab05470b0.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「I see...!
　The reason you two click so well right now
　must be the 'friends after a fight' rule!」

stage0049_03:r_7313331f4077d255.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Oh my, Master $$刹那$$...
　You're carrying something quite stylish, aren't you?」

stage0049_03:r_414e6e90094d1413.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「A gift for someone dear?
　You're quite the sly one too, Mr. Innovator」

stage0049_03:r_83a9e41e15444c69.text:
$$刹那$$
「No... I got this from $$シン$$」

stage0049_03:r_7b3a37f5039eb1f6.text:
$$刹那$$
「Does this look like a rose to you?」

stage0049_03:r_cb6d9ee71c24b042.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Uh... no... that's not what I meant...」

stage0049_03:r_ddd97a6ef823929a.text:
$$刹那$$
「Also, I received this from $$シン$$,
　but the giver was someone else」

stage0049_03:r_df349052cd9cdd0c.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「I see...
　That person must think very highly of Master $$刹那$$」

stage0049_03:r_de3cc1f733dcb073.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Wherever there's Z Chips... meaning
　I'm sensitive to the human heart, believe it or not.
　I can feel the feeling put into that flower」

stage0049_03:r_c32efc7394910997.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Why not repay them with a gift, Master $$刹那$$?
　If you'd like, I could pick one out for you」

stage0049_03:r_b01db8213417811e.text:
$$刹那$$
「No need.
　What she wants isn't something for sale」

stage0049_03:r_bc0273c6ae91c929.text:
$$刹那$$
「And that's also what we're after too」

stage0049_03:r_8deea7c70d7a76e7.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「I see...
　Well then, let's do our best toward that, Master $$刹那$$」

stage0049_03:r_5d8b67b5bd8ce190.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「To celebrate Celestial Being's new members,
　let's get fired up today too...」
